title: These are a pain
text:
These are a pain. even per the instructions, you have to let them sit on the counter a bit (however long) and then you have to break out each cube. You aren't supposed to twist them at all, which means one. cube. at. a time.
It's annoying for an ice tray. The trays I bought at the dollar store are quick, easy and done. I just threw them in the trash. You can clean the em easily. YAY, not
